regions.note: The Killed By picture: the killer's class icon (8 x 8, pixelated) in the 50 x 50 pfp box. FRVR's card sits 44 px lower (its bottom at the container's 10-unit inset): KN's Spectate button under the card lifts it by 44 px, so the reference is cropped at rect + (0, 44). Before the GAP rule in kn-strike-overrides.css the icon was drawn 8 x 50.
